description: This Java class 'RemoveUnneededTraces' is designed to optimize a PCB layout by removing unused segments and vias from a PCB design file. It reads a PCB structure from an input file, identifies unused components, and writes an optimized version to an output file.

classes.name: RemoveUnneededTraces
classes.description: Main class responsible for optimizing PCB layout by removing unused segments and vias.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program, parses command line arguments and initiates optimization.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Performs the optimization process by reading the input file, removing unused traces, and writing the output.

methods.name: removeUnusedVias
methods.description: Removes vias that are deemed unused based on connectivity checks.

methods.name: findUnusedVias
methods.description: Finds vias in the PCB layout that are not connected to enough segments or other vias.

methods.name: removeUnusedSegments
methods.description: Removes segments that are determined to be unused by connectivity analysis.

methods.name: findUnusedSegments
methods.description: Identifies segments that are not connected to modules or other segments, hence unused.

methods.name: isUnused
methods.description: Checks whether a given segment is unused based on connection status.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Determines if a point is connected to other elements like segments or modules.
